purpose: Declarative expected values for the TEI F0 reader. Values are derived from the OKF v0.2 specification text and the pinned fixture bytes, not copied from the reader's output. Cases that need a broken or bundle-root-absolute shape are declared here and constructed only in a temporary copy: a committed .md in this repository must keep its links resolvable (see testdata/okf-k1-v02.expected.json).
oracle_qualification: PROVISIONAL: written in the same work attempt as K1-A/K1-B. A separate independent review (#2514) and a mutant-kill proof are still required before this file is an accepted oracle.
expected_runtime_status: PARTIAL: the baseline and the diagnostic cases are executed by internal/okf; the mutating cases run on a temporary copy. No independent oracle has reproduced these values.

requiredObservations: STATUS_ABSENT on the root index is not a concept and is not reported there

cases.name: unknown type
mustNotInfer: the unknown type is a TEI role

cases.name: extra frontmatter keys
mustNotInfer: the extra keys are a TEI contract

cases.name: unparseable YAML
mustNotInfer: the raw bytes may be discarded

cases.name: empty type
cases.mutation: data/order.md: type -> "" (and, as separate sub-cases, "   " and ~)

cases.name: v0.1 shape
cases.mutation: data/order.md: replace with type + timestamp + body # Citations list
mustNotInfer: sources may be synthesized from the citations list

cases.name: source revision
mustNotInfer: the concept's acceptance or review is renewed by the revision

cases.name: A to B to A
cases.mutation: data/order.md: B then back to the original bytes, read as two independent copies
mustNotInfer: a previous acceptance, receipt, or review is restored by reverting bytes

cases.name: non-string type
mustNotInfer: the upstream reference's acceptance of a truthy list is specification conformance
cases.specimenDifference: The pinned upstream reference accepts any truthy value; SPEC section 4.1 requires a short string. This reader follows the specification.

cases.name: missing frontmatter
mustNotInfer: the body-only file may be silently skipped

cases.name: index frontmatter outside the root
mustNotInfer: frontmatter is permitted in any index

cases.name: ambiguous relative path
cases.mutation: a concept under concepts/ whose sources resource 'shared.md' exists both at concepts/shared.md and shared.md
mustNotInfer: the document-relative candidate is authoritative by proximity

cases.name: verified shapes
cases.mutation: data/order.md: verified as bare mapping, {}, {at only}, scalar, []
mustNotInfer: a human: label is an authenticated identity

cases.name: attested computation declarations
cases.mutation: add a concept with runtime, parameters, executor.resource, attester.resource, and a # Computation fence

cases.name: limits
cases.mutation: operation option, not a document change: maxFileBytes below a file size
mustNotInfer: a truncated digest describes the author's bytes

cases.name: traversal by symlink
cases.mutation: operation setup: a symlink inside the bundle pointing outside
cases.skipOn: platforms where symlink creation is not permitted
mustNotInfer: the link target is safe because it is on disk

readerCaveats: Body links are found with a structural Markdown scanner, not a full CommonMark parser; a link form the scanner does not recognize is reported as not enumerated rather than guessed.
The reader lists .md documents only; a path-valued field may name a non-Markdown file and resolves by presence on disk, whose content is never read.
`os.Root` prevents traversal escapes for the files the reader opens; it is not an OS sandbox and does not prove network or process isolation (#2515).
The reader does not implement OKF index.md synthesis, tag aggregation, or the Attested Computation runtime.
